entries.567a9aaf45b8caf2: This business manufactures salmon sushi toppings, grilled and simmered fish products, and others, at the company's own group plant in Myanmar and a partner plant in Vietnam. In addition to raw materials from the aquaculture business, it processes and sells raw materials procured from around the world. The company's Tokyo Business Division is in charge of trade operations and production management at the overseas processing plants. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥9,418 million.
entries.6037a86ad4d1215a: This business farms salmon trout for raw consumption and sells it in Japan and overseas. At Musholm A/S in Denmark, approximately 3,500 tons to slightly over 4,000 tons of salmon trout are produced each year, and salmon roe is also produced through farming that retains the eggs. In Japan, Nihon Salmon Farm Co., Ltd. carries out integrated production from hatching to farming in Aomori Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥7,529 million.
entries.769844b493b98daa: This business involves subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, Hong Kong and the Netherlands selling Japanese food ingredients imported from Japan to local Japanese supermarkets and Japanese restaurants. Products farmed and processed within the company's own group are also sold to overseas markets through this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥15,271 million.
entries.86d6869d53552508: This business processes and sells herring roe, pollock roe, salmon roe, salted salmon roe and the group's farmed salmon at the First to Third Plants in Aomori City, Aomori Prefecture. Sales are mainly to domestic supermarkets and food service operators, and exports to major conveyor-belt sushi chains in Asia are also increasing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥10,505 million.
entries.91968a54ee51e67e: Nihon Salmon Farm Co., Ltd. produces salmon trout in Fukaura Town, Nishitsugaru District, Aomori Prefecture, and other areas. Drawing on know-how from Musholm A/S's large-scale production, it has built an integrated production system from hatching to farming.
entries.c75e36ecdc8d2396: A seafood group centered on salmon, handling everything from aquaculture to processing and wholesale of Japanese food ingredients overseas.
entries.e5cbd2c4e6451ae8: Local sales bases in Singapore, Malaysia and others
entries.e9fbb001df02b09e: Musholm A/S produces salmon trout in Denmark. Fish flesh is sold to European countries as raw material for smoked salmon processing, and eggs are sold across Europe as salmon roe. Some is exported to the company and used in the domestic processing business.
